questions.q: Why were the tribes' idols placed in the Kaaba?
options: As a guarantee of safety for Quraysh
Because Prophet Ibrahim told them to
Because the Kaaba was too empty
questions.explain: Idols were placed as a guarantee for Quraysh's trade safety.

questions.q: For how long did the Prophet SAW trade to Sham and Yemen according to the lecture?
questions.explain: He saw the state of Rome and Persia himself.

options: Eastern Rome, from Turkey to Sham, Egypt and East Africa
Slaves forced to fight as entertainment in the colosseum
questions.explain: Romans sold children and slaves into gladiatorial fights under tax pressure.

questions.q: How does Islam treat widows compared with India at that time?
options: It honours widows and allows them to remarry
It forbids widows from going out
questions.explain: In India widows were despised and barred from remarrying; Islam honours widows.

questions.q: What first word of Al-Alaq shows a distinctive feature of Islam?
questions.explain: Unlike religions that bar ordinary people from reading scripture, the Quran begins with "read".

questions.q: What example did the Prophet SAW set regarding the good already found among the Arabs?
options: Seeking existing good to correct the bad
questions.explain: Use the good in every people.

questions.q: Religion may be used as a tool to legitimise a king's power.
questions.explain: False. A king as God's representative enables oppression in the name of religion.

questions.q: On embracing Islam, people of low caste gained equality in the prayer rows.
Match each caste with its meaning.

right.text: The caste of traders and farmers
The caste of labourers and workers
The caste of warriors and politicians
The highest caste: priests and scholars

questions.explain: Brahmin is highest, Kshatriya warriors, Vaishya traders and farmers, and Shudra labourers.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW lived near Persians and Jews. What is our task according to this lecture?
options: To be a light, not to run away
questions.explain: Even the Prophet SAW was sent as a mercy to all the worlds.
